nodes.question: What are some solutions and integrated strategies for the control and mitigation of plastic and microplastic pollution?
nodes.answer: Some solutions and integrated strategies for the control and mitigation of plastic and microplastic pollution include the implementation of recycling programs, reducing single-use plastic consumption, promoting sustainable packaging alternatives, and conducting clean-up initiatives in water bodies.
